title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic mirror-selfie photograph of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, posing confidently inside a modern, softly illuminated bathroom. Capture an intimate, elegant, subtly glamorous atmosphere in a vertical composition, framing her from the top of her head to her upper thighs, with a large white ceramic washbasin occupying the lower foreground. Position her centrally in front of a wall-mounted mirror, with dark wooden double doors directly behind her.

She has a softly oval face, delicate jawline, naturally proportioned facial features, and smooth, warm light-to-medium skin with subtle golden undertones. Most of her face is obscured by a smartphone held vertically in her right hand, covering her eyes, nose, and much of her mouth. Only portions of her cheeks, forehead, and lower face remain visible. Her expression appears relaxed, composed, and quietly confident as she looks toward the smartphone screen. Her dark brown, nearly black hair is styled in a simple, loosely gathered low updo, with a center part and soft strands framing her face.

Her figure is slender yet naturally curvaceous, with gently defined shoulders, a narrow waist, and harmonious proportions. She stands facing the mirror with her torso slightly angled, her left arm extending diagonally downward and her left hand resting flat against the speckled beige stone countertop beside the sink. Her fingernails are painted a dark glossy shade. Her right elbow is bent, positioning the smartphone directly in front of her face. A small, narrow black tattoo is visible along the inner side of her right wrist, with another subtle tattoo partially visible near her upper arm.

She wears a fitted, dark chocolate-brown, nearly black mini dress featuring a deep V-shaped neckline, delicate spaghetti straps, a softly structured bust, and distinctive off-the-shoulder flutter sleeves made from lightweight, slightly sheer, textured fabric. The neckline features gently gathered fabric and subtle lace-like edging. The dress closely follows her natural waist and hips, with understated diagonal seam detailing across the fitted bodice. Preserve the exact asymmetrical draping and relaxed placement of the sleeves.

The smartphone has a colorful illustrated protective case with a prominent square multi-camera module. The bathroom features large pale beige stone-effect wall tiles, symmetrical chrome wall hooks, warm walnut-colored double doors with vertical woodgrain patterns, and a recessed circular ceiling light. The foreground includes a glossy rectangular white vessel sink with softly rounded corners and a polished chrome faucet.

Use realistic indoor overhead lighting, gentle warm highlights across her shoulders and décolletage, soft natural shadows, subtle mirror reflections, authentic skin texture, and detailed fabric rendering. Simulate a high-quality smartphone camera with a 26mm equivalent wide-angle lens, realistic perspective, moderate depth of field, restrained sharpening, natural dynamic range, and slightly warm neutral color grading. Maintain the candid, unretouched quality of a genuine bathroom mirror selfie, with accurate anatomy, realistic hands, natural proportions, and believable reflections. Vertical aspect ratio 9:16.
